# P03 Regulatory Gap Analysis: Cris Santos Company | Accommodation and Food Services | Micro: Hotel operator

| Scenario brief | [README.md](../README.md) |

**Regulation to analyze:** PCI DSS v4.0.1, PCI SSC PCI DSS v4.0.1 (contractual standard)
**Why:** Payment card data is the dominant regulated data type in hotels and restaurants, and the largest share of sector breaches involve POS/PMS card data. PCI DSS is the only prescriptive, externally validated control set these businesses are held to (contractually). There is no federal sector cyber statute; FTC Section 5 and state laws judge 'reasonableness', which PCI compliance evidences.
